pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pCollects nearby item entities into the inventory directly below it using an eight-slot filter.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Put representative items in filter slots.$p2. Choose whitelist/blacklist and item/tag versus component matching.$p3. Place a receiving inventory underneath and remove a disabling redstone signal.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pAn entity remains in the world when transfer is blocked. Filter mode, range or a full inventory can explain no collection.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
